episodes.title: Cults: Could You Walk Away?
episodes.description: Coercive control is where Shane Hewitt starts when he asks what makes a group a cult. If you've ever walked out of a course wondering what you'd just signed up for, he offers a question you can use to sort out what felt off. A group can ask a lot of its members. Listen for what changes when it starts shaping who you spend time with and what you're allowed to believe. Shane gets into how that pressure can reach into the rest of your life. How much say do you still have when you disagree? Shane makes the question practical by looking at what happens when you decide you've had enough. Topics: Coercive control, cult warning signs, voluntary membership, isolation, group pressure Originally aired on 2026-11-06

episodes.title: ICYMI: The Queen of Canada: Conspiracies and Cult Dynamics
episodes.description:
What happens when conspiracy theories collide with real-life consequences? Nathan Radke joins Shane Hewitt to examine Romana de Dulo, the self-proclaimed Queen of Canada, and the cult-like dynamics surrounding her movement. The conversation unpacks how stress, community, and belief systems can make people vulnerable to dangerous ideologies, drawing parallels to historical examples like Heaven’s Gate and Waco. This episode explores the psychological costs of conspiracy thinking — and why critical awareness matters more than ever.
 GUEST Nathan Radke @theuncoverup
 Originally aired on 2025-09-17
